query:
SELECT 
  s.id, 
  DATE(s.saleDate) as saleDate,
  s.status,
  si.productId,
  p.name as productName,
  si.quantity,
  si.totalPrice
FROM sales s
INNER JOIN saleItems si ON s.id = si.saleId
INNER JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE s.id IN (13620026, 13620024, 13620015)
  AND p.name LIKE '%Baly%Maça%Verde%'
ORDER BY s.saleDate, s.id;
